raw_text: Manipur burns: Ethnic violence erupts between Meitei and Kuki communities. At least 10 people are feared dead as ethnic violence broke out in multiple districts of Manipur on Wednesday following a tribal solidarity march against the Meitei community's demand for Scheduled Tribe status. Videos circulating on social media show houses and churches on fire, armed mobs on streets, and displaced families fleeing to relief camps. The state government has imposed curfew in all districts and called in the Indian Army. Internet services have been suspended across the state. The violence is the worst the state has seen since the 1990s insurgency period. District administrations are struggling to contain the situation with inadequate security forces.
